messages.content: "你能告訴我著名足球運動員莱萊納爾·梅西的淨資產是多少歐元嗎？之後，我想知道籃球運動員勒布朗·詹姆斯的淨資產是多少英鎊。此外，我對一個使用公制系統的重85公斤、身高180公分的人的身體質量指數（BMI）也很好奇。最後，你能計算一個使用英制系統的重200磅、身高6英呎2英吋的人的BMI嗎？"

function.name: calculate_bmi
function.description: Calculate the Body Mass Index (BMI) of a person. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

weight.description: Weight of the person in kilograms.

height.description: Height of the person in centimeters.

unit.description: Optional parameter to choose between 'imperial' and 'metric' systems. Default is 'metric'.

function.name: celebrity_net_worth_get
function.description: Get the total net worth of a sports celebrity based on most recent data. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The full name of the sports celebrity.

currency.description: The currency in which the net worth will be returned. Default is 'USD'.

message.reasoning:

2. Net worth of LeBron James in pounds. Use celebrity_net_worth_get with name "LeBron James", currency "GBP".
3. BMI of a person using metric system: weight 85 kg, height 180 cm. Use calculate_bmi with weight=85, height=180, unit="metric".
4. BMI of a person using imperial system: weight 200 lbs, height 6 ft 2 in. But calculate_bmi expects weight in kilograms and height in centimeters. However, we can pass unit="imperial" and weight in pounds? Wait the function signature: weight: number, height: number, unit?: string. It says weight in kilograms, height in centimeters. But optional unit param chooses between 'imperial' and 'metric', default 'metric'. So if we want imperial, we need to provide weight in pounds and height in inches? Or maybe the function expects weight in kilograms and height in centimeters regardless of unit? The description says "Weight of the person in kilograms." "Height of the person in centimeters." So it's ambiguous. But the function also has unit param. Usually such functions accept weight in kilograms or pounds depending on unit. So we should pass weight in pounds and height in inches when unit='imperial'. So weight=200, height=74 (6*12+2), unit='imperial'.

Thus we need to call celebrity_net_worth_get twice, calculate_bmi twice.
